race.comment: PLUME (10) put in an encouraging effort first up at Newcastle, in the market there and boxing on gamely for second, beaten under a length. Fitter for that and will be very hard to run down. ARGANSORT (2) has been thereabouts in two runs to date, in the market both times. Don't mind him back to 1200m here and expected to improve for the top yard. HO ALOHA (8) placed second by a long neck last start at Kembla Grange and expected to go forward here. Sets up well from the inside and is in the mix. CRASH BANG WALLOP (7) was solid on debut over 1000m here and fitter is sure to make her presence felt.
